CustomField.description: The middle number entered for a number or currency question: half the answers are at or below it. Exact when the question has 200 or fewer different answers; otherwise read from the ranges the answers fall in, so approximate. Blank for any other question.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The middle number entered: half the answers are at or below it. Approximate when there are many different answers.
CustomField.label: Number Median
